context:
Goal: your 219 a ruling governs.
Problem (rule): the cloud refuses any session's edit of .claude/CLAUDE.md as self-modification. So #1247 waits on you to paste the new bullet. It also now conflicts with main.
Based on (read): #1247's body, 'Owner pastes this'; main's .claude/CLAUDE.md still has the three-act bullet.
Departs from: main lets a Mac session do three cloud-refused acts for the claude-settings coordinator — any repo's coordinator may ask, and PR closes leave the list.

options.label: Make the edit: a lane rebases #1247, then you paste the bullet at the link it sends (recommended)
Drop it: close #1247 and keep today's bullet

short: Idle PR #1247: your item 219 a grant edit
title: Idle PR #1247 carries your Nov 4 ruling (item 219 a) but waits on a CLAUDE.md edit only you can make: make it, or drop the change?
why: Main still shows the old 'Acts the cloud refuses' bullet three days after your ruling.
